note: Nepal's largest banks include Nabil, Global IME, NIC Asia and the state-owned Nepal Bank. Nabil's card page sits behind Cloudflare (not passed), NIC Asia's card URL answers 404 and Global IME's site didn't answer (2026-10-30), so Nepal Bank Limited, this file's bank since 2026-10-29, is written alone. Nepal Bank Limited's credit card page (read again 2026-10-30): its Visa domestic credit card (valid only in Nepal, India and Bhutan) charges 2% a month (24% a year) on purchases and on cash; a joining fee of 750 rupees (now written as the issue fee) and an annual fee of 750; a payment of 10% of the outstanding, at least 1,000 rupees, written as the minimum; 15 to 45 days free of interest on purchases, written as 45; a late payment 300 rupees each time; over the limit 500 rupees; a cash withdrawal 100 rupees at the bank's own ATMs (200 at other Visa ATMs and 250 in India, not written). The page states no foreign-transaction fee (the card works in India and Bhutan too) and none is written.
